## ESC

Code for the B-G431B-ESC1 motor controller using the SimpleFOC library:
[FAAV-G431-ESC](https://github.com/MIT-AURA-Lab/FAAV-G431-ESC).

Used in [Module 3](/sessions/03-esc.qmd) and
[Module 4](/sessions/04-control.qmd).

## Flight controller

- **Current** --- ESP32, based on FreeRTOS tasks:
  [FAAV-Flight-Controller](https://github.com/MIT-AURA-Lab/FAAV-Flight-Controller)

Outdated versions, kept for reference:

- Old EPFL code for NRF52: [FAAV-Seeeduino](https://github.com/MIT-AURA-Lab/FAAV-Seeeduino)
- Old MIT code for NRF52/ESP32: [FAAV-AUK](https://github.com/MIT-AURA-Lab/FAAV-AUK)

## PCB

- [FAAV-PCB-v3](https://github.com/MIT-AURA-Lab/FAAV-PCB-v3) --- current board,
  including the BOM in the Manufacturing/Assembly folder

## Access

Confirm before the semester that students have read access to these
repositories, and pin the branch or tag each module expects. "Latest main"
changing under a cohort mid-semester is the most likely way this manual goes
stale without anyone noticing.
:::
